title: Story premise ENT074: The Scuffed Dance Floor
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (silent emotional stories). Hook: The floor remembers every attempt. Takeaway/theme: Traces of practice can belong in the finished work.
description: A dancer wants to perform on a spotless floor and keeps wiping away every rehearsal mark. When the cloth becomes worn out, they step back and notice the remaining marks trace the dance; they leave the path visible and perform along it for one quiet spectator.
